scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:skills && npm run setup:gcloud
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run verify:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared
scripts.check:full: npm run verify:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:wire: node scripts/verify-doc-paths.mjs && npm run test:wire -w packages/shared && npm run test:wire -w apps/server && npm run test:wire -w apps/web
